headline: BeNice! reports near-lossless KV sharing and lower simulated serving costs for looped language models
summary: A new arXiv paper proposes BeNice!, a post-training method intended to make KV-cache sharing reliable in looped language models. The authors report near-matching shared and unshared validation quality on tested Parcae checkpoints, a 66.2% global HBM reduction for a 1.3B model at recurrence eight, and throughput/TTFT gains in simulated replay using proxy models. These are paper-reported results; independent reproduction and transfer to live deployments or other architectures remain open.
